title: PixityReborn
description: We are a custom server, one that has been in development for about a year that is getting ready to release. We have Custom fishing, farming, skills, pokehunts, outbreaks, playerwarps and oh so much more!
body:
After countless hours of building, balancing, custom development, and polishing, we're excited to finally open the server and welcome everyone in for launch day!

✨ What’s Available at Launch? ✨

🎣 Custom Fishing
🌾 Custom Farming
⭐ Custom Skills System
🎯 Global & Personal PokéHunts
🎉 PokéPartys (Vote Partys)
🌍 Pokémon Outbreaks
🪧 Player Sign Shops
💰 Auction House
📦 Stacking Mobs & Spawners
🏠 PlayerWarps

🏆 Milestones & Progression Systems
Progress through milestone rewards for:
⛏️ Mining
🎣 Fishing
🌾 Farming
⚔️ Mob Kills
🔴 Pokémon Captures
🎪 Events
⬆️ Pokémon Leveling

🔥 Exclusive Launch Content 🔥

Start your adventure with one of our 4 Exclusive Launch Variant Starter Lines:

🐉 Dratini Line
🔥 Charmander Line
🌱 Bulbasaur Line
💧 Squirtle Line

These limited-time launch variants are exclusive to our server launch and will be available to players joining the adventure from day one!

🎁 Launch Crate Rewards
Every player can receive exclusive Launch Tools available through the Launch Crate to help kickstart your journey.
